content: तुज्, तुञ्ज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (तुञ्जति; also <ab>Ā.</ab> and €10 <ab>P.</ab>) <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 To reach, extend, convey. .²2 To kill, hurt, injure. .²3 To guard, protect. .²4 To clothe. .²5 To live. .²6 To strike, hit. .²7 To push. .²8 To emit, send forth. .²9 To incite, instigate, urge onwards. .²10 To give. .²11 To press out. .²12 To flow forth; सुरेतसा श्रवसा तुञ्जमाना <ls>Rv. 3. 1. 16</ls>.
